claims.title: A passive hydraulic isolation model has a conditional shunt assay and explicit noise/work limits

status: Source claims plus separate internal advances; externally unreviewed.
interface: Steady reciprocal unbiased wet laws with actual K,G>0,C^2<KG and a measured complete passive dry terminal admittance. The composed hydraulic matrix and circuit topology are conditional models. Common-temperature classical Gaussian/FDT, ideal waveform/load and isolated-shunt invariant-wet-law hypotheses are additional stated contracts. No complete neutral-liquid transducer or hydraulic isolator was built or measured.
limits: Acquire unbiased steady reciprocal neutral-liquid/electronic cross-coefficients on the same device and complete dry terminal response/noise. Execute isolated-shunt two-level identification with a held-out third load, field reversal, direct-effect/open-path/reciprocal controls and propagated uncertainty. Compare useful flow/signal and full gross donor/output/auxiliary work with conventional control before physical or technological promotion; historical priority remains unestablished.
